legacy_aliases.DOOR_FACE_W: deprecated name; use DOOR_ENVELOPE_W. Existing Fusion features may keep the old parameter name until deliberately migrated.
legacy_aliases.DOOR_FACE_H: deprecated name; use DOOR_ENVELOPE_H. Existing Fusion features may keep the old parameter name until deliberately migrated.

derived_or_tbd.DOOR_PLANAR_W: derived from the formed sheet-metal bend geometry; CAD-001 restored baseline measured about 84.8 mm
derived_or_tbd.DOOR_PLANAR_H: derived from the formed sheet-metal bend geometry; CAD-001 restored baseline measured about 41.6 mm
derived_or_tbd.CABINET_BODY_W: derive from final outer-side geometry; control bay must match it exactly
derived_or_tbd.BLUE_SHIELD_FRONT_SETBACK: derive along +Y from corrected CAD-003 catch sweep at BLUE_SHIELD_PARTITION_X plus CATCH_SWEEP_CLEAR
derived_or_tbd.RED_WALL_DEPTH: derive from final XG-07A placement; stop near rear edge of lock to open into service channel
derived_or_tbd.SOL_SHIM_T: derive from actual U-catch/XG-07A hook alignment; expected roughly 7-8 mm initially
derived_or_tbd.MAIN_HINGE_AXIS_OFFSET: derive from chosen hinge hardware and 90-degree cabinet swing
derived_or_tbd.MASTER_LOCK_OFFSETS: derive from actual Solex placement and 25x25x3 angle geometry
derived_or_tbd.CONTROL_H_FINAL: derive from actual horizontal Display-Keypad-QR packaging

rules.door_planar_rule: DOOR_PLANAR_W/H are derived results, never independent controlling dimensions
